en: Standing on the promises of Christ my King,
Through eternal ages let His praises ring
Glory in the highest, I will shout and sing,
Standing on the promises of God.
Standing on the promises that cannot fail,
When the howling
storms of doubt and fear assail,
By the living Word of God I shall prevail,
Standing on the promises of God.

ko: 성령의 검을 들고 구원의 투구를 쓰고
en: Take the sword of the Spirit,
Wear the helmet of salvation,
With the shield of faith and the belt of truth,
Stand firm on the Word.

ko: 성령의 검을 들고 구원의 투구를 쓰고
en: Take the sword of the Spirit,
Wear the helmet of salvation,
Hold firmly to the Word of God,
Standing on the promises of the Lord,
Strengthened by His eternal love,
Fighting and winning through the Spirit,
Standing firmly on His promises.
Standing on the promises of the Lord,
Walking as the Spirit leads,
Always finding rest in His embrace,
Standing firmly on His promises.

ko: 성령의 검을 들고 구원의 투구를 쓰고
en: Take the sword of the Spirit,
Wear the helmet of salvation,
With the shield of faith and the belt of truth,
Stand firm on the Word.

ko: 성령의 검을 들고 구원의 투구를 쓰고
en: Take the sword of the Spirit,
Wear the helmet of salvation,
Hold firmly to the Word of God,

ko: 굳게 서리 그 말씀 위에 굳게 서리라
en: Stand firm, stand firm,
Stand firm, stand firmly on the Word.
